title_en: Forms of Evidence Documents for Administrative Litigation of the Supreme People's Court (for Trial Implementation)

Form 1
___ People's Court
Notice of Acceptance of Case

( ) __ Zi No. __

___:

Your complaint in the case of your action against (defendant) (cause of action) has been received, and this court has decided to accept the case. The relevant matters are hereby notified as follows:

1. During the proceedings, the parties have the right to exercise the procedural rights provided by law, and must simultaneously abide by the procedural order and perform their procedural obligations.
2. If a natural person participates in the proceedings, he or she shall submit an identity certificate. If a legal person or other organization participates in the proceedings, it shall, within ten days from receipt of this notice, submit its legal person or other organization qualification certificate and the identity certificate of its legal representative or responsible person.
3. If a representative is needed to act as agent ad litem, a power of attorney signed or sealed by the principal shall be submitted to this court. The power of attorney shall specify the entrusted matters and the scope of authority.

___ Year ___ Month ___ Day

(Court Seal)

Explanation:
This notice is served on the plaintiff.

Form 2
___ People's Court
Notice of Participation in Proceedings

( ) __ Zi No. __

___:

After accepting the case of (plaintiff) v. (defendant) (cause of action), this court found that you have a legal interest in the disposition of this case. Pursuant to Article 27 of the Administrative Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, you are hereby notified to participate in the proceedings as a third party in this case. The matters concerning participation in the proceedings are hereby notified as follows:

1. During the proceedings, the parties have the right to exercise the procedural rights provided by law, and must simultaneously abide by the procedural order and perform their procedural obligations.
2. If a natural person participates in the proceedings, he or she shall, within ten days from receipt of this notice, submit an identity certificate. If a legal person or other organization participates in the proceedings, it shall, within ten days from receipt of this notice, submit its legal person or other organization qualification certificate and the identity certificate of its legal representative or responsible person.
3. If a representative is needed to act as agent ad litem, a power of attorney signed or sealed by the principal shall be submitted to this court. The power of attorney shall specify the entrusted matters and the scope of authority.

___ Year ___ Month ___ Day

(Court Seal)

Explanation:
This notice is served on the third party. If there are other matters to be notified, a separate line may be added to continue.

Form 3
___ People's Court
Notice of Response to Action

(For use in notifying the defendant and appellee)

( ) __ Zi No. __

___:

This court has accepted the case of (name of plaintiff or appellant) v. your side (cause of action). A copy of the complaint is hereby sent to you. The relevant matters are hereby notified as follows:

1. During the proceedings, the parties must exercise their procedural rights in accordance with the law, and must simultaneously abide by the procedural order and perform their procedural obligations.
2. Your side shall submit ___ copies of the statement of defense to this court within ten days from receipt of the complaint.
3. If a legal person or other organization participates in the proceedings, it shall submit its legal person or other organization qualification certificate and the identity certificate of its legal representative or responsible person. If a natural person participates in the proceedings, he or she shall submit an identity certificate.
4. If a representative is needed to act as agent ad litem, a power of attorney signed or sealed by the principal shall be submitted. The power of attorney shall specify the entrusted matters and scope of authority in accordance with the law.

___ Year ___ Month ___ Day

(Court Seal)

Explanation:
This notice is served on the defendant or appellee.

Form 4
___ People's Court
Notice of Composition of the Collegial Panel and the Clerk for the Administrative Case

( ) __ Zi No. __

___:

This court has accepted the case of plaintiff (or appellant) ___ v. defendant (or appellee) (party's name and cause of action) administrative litigation (or appeal). Pursuant to Article 46 of the Administrative Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, it is decided that ___ shall serve as the presiding judge, and together with judge (acting judge) ___ and ___ shall form the collegial panel to hear the case, with ___ serving as the clerk.

Pursuant to Article 47 of the Administrative Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China and Article 47 of the Supreme People's Court's Interpretation on Several Issues Concerning the Implementation of the Administrative Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, if a party believes that a judicial officer has an interest in the case or has another relationship that may affect a fair trial, that party has the right to apply for withdrawal, but shall state the reasons; a party may apply for withdrawal when the trial of the case commences; if the grounds for withdrawal become known after the trial has commenced, the application shall be made before the conclusion of court debate.

The above matters are hereby notified.

___ Year ___ Month ___ Day

(Court Seal)

Explanation:
This notice form is for use by people's courts at all levels when notifying the parties after accepting an administrative case and determining the composition of the collegial panel.

Form 5
___ People's Court
Notice of Change in Composition of the Collegial Panel and the Clerk

( ) __ Zi No. __

___:

In the case of plaintiff (or appellant) ___ v. defendant (or appellee) (party's name and cause of action) administrative litigation (or appeal) accepted by this court, due to (state reason for change), the composition of the collegial panel for this case needs to be changed. It is decided that ___ shall serve as the presiding judge, and together with judge (acting judge) ___ and ___ shall form the collegial panel to hear the case, with ___ serving as the clerk.

Pursuant to Article 47 of the Administrative Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China and Article 47 of the Supreme People's Court's Interpretation on Several Issues Concerning the Implementation of the Administrative Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, if a party believes that a judicial officer has an interest in the case or has another relationship that may affect a fair trial, that party has the right to apply for withdrawal, but shall state the reasons; the application may be made when the trial of the case commences; if the grounds for withdrawal become known after the trial has commenced, the application shall be made before the conclusion of court debate.

The above matters are hereby notified.

___ Year ___ Month ___ Day

(Court Seal)

Explanation:
This notice form is for use by people's courts at all levels when notifying the parties after changing the judicial officers and re-forming the collegial panel.

Form 6
___ People's Court
Notice of Burden of Proof

(For use by the defendant in providing evidence)

( ) __ Zi No. __

___:

Pursuant to the Administrative Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China and the Supreme People's Court's Provisions on Several Issues Concerning Evidence in Administrative Litigation (hereinafter referred to as the "Provisions on Evidence"), the matters concerning the burden of proof are hereby notified as follows:

1. Your side shall, within ten days from receipt of the copy of the complaint, provide all the evidence on which the specific administrative act complained of was based and the normative documents on which it was based. Failure to provide evidence or providing evidence beyond the time limit without justifiable reasons shall be deemed that the specific administrative act complained of has no corresponding evidence.

If due to force majeure or other objectively uncontrollable justifiable reasons, you are unable to provide evidence within the aforementioned time limit, you shall, within ten days from receipt of the copy of the complaint, submit a written application to the People's Court for an extension of time to provide evidence. If the People's Court grants the extension, evidence shall be provided within ten days after the justifiable reasons are eliminated. If evidence is provided beyond this extended time limit, it shall be deemed that the specific administrative act complained of has no corresponding evidence.

2. If your side believes that the plaintiff's action exceeds the statutory time limit, you shall bear the burden of proof. If the plaintiff or the third party raises grounds of rebuttal or evidence not raised during the administrative process, with the permission of the People's Court, your side may supplement corresponding evidence during the first-instance proceedings.

3. During the litigation process, your side and your agents ad litem shall not collect evidence from the plaintiff and witnesses on their own.

4. Your side may, in accordance with the requirements of the Provisions on Evidence, provide documentary evidence, physical evidence, audio-visual materials, witness testimony, expert conclusions, on-site records, evidence formed outside the territory of the People's Republic of China, and foreign-written documentary evidence or audio-visual materials. If the evidence involves state secrets, trade secrets, or personal privacy, it shall be clearly marked and explained to the court, which shall review and confirm it.

When providing evidence to the People's Court, you shall classify and number the evidentiary materials, briefly describe the name of the evidentiary materials, their object of proof, and their content, sign or seal them, indicate the date of submission, and submit an evidence list according to the number of opposing parties.

5. If your side applies to the People's Court to investigate and collect evidence, you shall submit a written application for the investigation and collection of evidence within the time limit for providing evidence. The application shall state the name and address of the holder of the evidence, the content of the evidence sought to be collected, the reasons for the application, and the case facts to be proved.

If evidence may be destroyed or become difficult to obtain later, you may apply to the People's Court for preservation of evidence. An application for preservation of evidence shall be submitted in writing before the expiration of the time limit for providing evidence, stating the name and location of the evidence, the content and scope of preservation, and the reasons for the application.

When applying for preservation of evidence, corresponding security shall be provided to the court.

6. If your side believes that the expert conclusion made by the institution commissioned by the People's Court has circumstances as provided in Article 30 of the Provisions on Evidence, you may apply for a re-examination.

If your side bears the burden of proof for matters requiring expert evaluation, and fails to apply for evaluation within the time limit for providing evidence without justifiable reasons, fails to advance the evaluation fees, or refuses to provide relevant materials, resulting in the inability to determine the disputed facts of the case through the evaluation conclusion, your side shall bear the legal consequences of failure to provide proof.

7. An application for a witness to testify in court shall be made before the expiration of the time limit for providing evidence. Upon application, the People's Court may examine whether the witness is capable of correctly expressing his or her will or may commission an expert evaluation.

The reasonable expenses incurred by the witnesses and experts provided by your side for appearing in court to testify or be questioned shall be prepaid by your side and borne by the losing party.

8. For facts that are not disputed by the parties but that involve state interests, public interests, or the lawful rights and interests of others, the People's Court has the right to require your side to provide or supplement relevant evidence.

9. In the procedure of evidence exchange organized by the People's Court, your side shall present or exchange evidence with the opposing party.

10. If a party engages in any of the acts of forging, concealing, or destroying evidence; inducing, bribing, or coercing others to provide false testimony; or threatening or preventing witnesses from testifying, the People's Court may, depending on the seriousness of the circumstances, reprimand the party, order a statement of repentance, or impose a fine of not more than RMB 1,000 or detention for not more than 15 days; if the act constitutes a crime, criminal liability shall be pursued according to law. If a party is dissatisfied with the sanction decision, it may apply to the People's Court that made the decision for reconsideration.

___ Year ___ Month ___ Day

(Court Seal)

Explanation:
This notice is applicable to first-instance proceedings.

Form 7
___ People's Court
Notice of Burden of Proof

(For use by the plaintiff and third party in providing evidence)

( ) __ Zi No. __

___:

Pursuant to the Administrative Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China and the Supreme People's Court's Provisions on Several Issues Concerning Evidence in Administrative Litigation (hereinafter referred to as the "Provisions on Evidence"), the matters concerning the burden of proof are hereby notified as follows:

1. If the People's Court organizes pre-trial exchange of evidence, your side shall provide evidence on the designated date of evidence exchange; if no pre-trial exchange of evidence is organized, evidence shall be provided before the hearing. If no evidentiary materials are provided within the aforementioned time limit, it shall be deemed that you have waived the right to provide evidence.

If you apply for an extension of time to provide evidence due to justifiable reasons, you shall apply to the People's Court for an extension within the time limit for providing evidence. With the permission of the People's Court, the time limit for providing evidence may be appropriately extended.

If you submit evidentiary materials beyond the time limit, you shall state the reasons. If no reasons are given or the reasons are untenable, the People's Court will not organize cross-examination, unless the defendant agrees to cross-examination.

Evidence that is not provided without justifiable reasons in the first-instance proceedings but is provided in the second-instance proceedings will not be accepted by the People's Court.

2. Your side shall provide corresponding evidentiary materials that meet the conditions for filing the action. In cases where the defendant's inaction is sued, you shall also provide evidentiary materials demonstrating that an application was previously made during the administrative process, except in the following circumstances: (1) The matter for which you applied is a statutory duty that the defendant was required to perform ex officio; (2) You are unable to provide relevant evidentiary materials due to justifiable reasons such as the defendant's incomplete registration system for accepting applications and can provide a reasonable explanation.

In administrative compensation proceedings, your side shall provide evidence of the damage caused by the specific administrative act complained of.

You may also provide evidence proving that the specific administrative act complained of is illegal. If the evidence provided is insufficient, it does not relieve the defendant of the burden of proof regarding the legality of the specific administrative act complained of.

For facts that are not disputed by the parties but that involve state interests, public interests, or the lawful rights and interests of others, the People's Court has the right to require the parties to provide or supplement relevant evidence.

3. Your side may, in accordance with the requirements of the Provisions on Evidence, provide documentary evidence, physical evidence, audio-visual materials, witness testimony, evidence formed outside the territory of the People's Republic of China, and foreign-written documentary evidence or foreign language audio-visual materials. If the evidence involves state secrets, trade secrets, or personal privacy, it shall be clearly marked and explained to the court, which shall review and confirm it.

When providing evidence to the People's Court, you shall classify and number the evidentiary materials, briefly describe the name of the evidentiary materials, their object of proof, and their content, sign or seal them, indicate the date of submission, and submit an evidence list according to the number of opposing parties.

4. If you are unable to collect evidence on your own due to objective reasons but can provide specific clues, you may apply to the People's Court to investigate and collect evidence.

An application for the People's Court to investigate and collect evidence shall be submitted in writing within the time limit for providing evidence. The application shall state the name and address of the holder of the evidence, the content of the evidence sought to be collected, the reasons for the application, and the case facts to be proved.

5. If evidence may be destroyed or become difficult to obtain later, you may apply to the People's Court for preservation of evidence. An application for preservation of evidence shall be submitted in writing before the expiration of the time limit for providing evidence, stating the name and location of the evidence, the content and scope of preservation, and the reasons for the application.

When applying for preservation of evidence, corresponding security shall be provided to the court.

6. If there is evidence or justifiable reasons indicating that the expert conclusion on which the defendant bases its determination of case facts may be erroneous, you may apply in writing for a re-examination within the time limit for providing evidence.

If your side believes that the expert conclusion made by the institution commissioned by the People's Court has circumstances as provided in Article 30 of the Provisions on Evidence, you may apply for a re-examination.

If your side bears the burden of proof for matters requiring expert evaluation, and fails to apply for evaluation within the time limit for providing evidence without justifiable reasons, fails to advance the evaluation fees, or refuses to provide relevant materials, resulting in the inability to determine the disputed facts of the case through the evaluation conclusion, your side shall bear the legal consequences of failure to provide proof.

7. In the procedure of evidence exchange organized by the People's Court, your side shall present or exchange evidence with the opposing party.

8. The reasonable expenses incurred by the witnesses and experts provided by your side for appearing in court to testify or be questioned shall be prepaid by your side and borne by the losing party.

9. If a party engages in any of the acts of forging, concealing, or destroying evidence; inducing, bribing, or coercing others to provide false testimony; or threatening or preventing witnesses from testifying, the People's Court may, depending on the seriousness of the circumstances, reprimand the party, order a statement of repentance, or impose a fine of not more than RMB 1,000 or detention for not more than 15 days; if the act constitutes a crime, criminal liability shall be pursued according to law. If a party is dissatisfied with the sanction decision, it may apply to the People's Court that made the decision for reconsideration.

___ Year ___ Month ___ Day

(Court Seal)

Explanation: This notice is applicable to first-instance proceedings.

Form 8
___ People's Court
Notice

(Granting Extension of Time Limit for Providing Evidence)

( ) __ Zi No. __

___:

In the case between your side and (name of opposing party and cause of action), you filed an application to this court on ___ Year ___ Month ___ Day for an extension of time to provide evidence, citing (reasons for applying for extension) and stating that you have difficulty in providing evidence within the time limit for providing evidence.

Upon review, your application meets the provisions of Article 1, Paragraph 2 (or Article 7) of the Supreme People's Court's Provisions on Several Issues Concerning Evidence in Administrative Litigation. This court hereby grants the extension. The time limit for providing evidence in this case is extended to ___ Year ___ Month ___ Day.

___ Year ___ Month ___ Day

(Court Seal)

1. This Notice applies to the circumstances under Article 1, Paragraph 2 (or Article 7) of the Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning Evidence in Administrative Litigation.

2. This Notice shall be served on both parties and the third party.

Form No. 9

______ People's Court

Notice

(Denial of Extension of Time for Evidence Production)

(______) ______ Case No. ______

______:

In the case concerning (the name of the opposing party and the cause of action), you filed an application with this court on ______ (year) ______ (month) ______ (day) for an extension of time for evidence production, on the ground that (the reasons for applying for extension of time for evidence production) you indeed had difficulty submitting evidence within the time limit for evidence production.

Upon examination, the reasons you stated for extending the time for evidence production are not established. In accordance with Article 1, Paragraph 2 (or Article 7) of the Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning Evidence in Administrative Litigation, this court shall not grant the extension.

______ (year) ______ (month) ______ (day)

(Court Seal)

Notes:

1. This Notice applies to the circumstances under Article 1, Paragraph 2 (or Article 7) of the Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning Evidence in Administrative Litigation.

2. This Notice shall be served on the applicant. The contents of this Notice may be orally communicated to the applicant by the people's court, and shall be recorded in the court record, signed by the party or the agent ad litem.

(To be continued)
